patch_description: This update optimizes the entry hurdles by re-introducing session-specific thresholds (US session lower for high volatility, Asia higher for low volatility) and refining the range-positioning logic using multiplicative factors. It also improves position sizing by cautiously increasing the base exposure and cap, while adding an ATR-based scaling penalty for high-volatility environments to protect capital. Entry filters are strengthened with VWAP deviation limits and tighter funding constraints, and take-profit targets are expanded for trending markets to capture more upside.
